title: senecio oophyllus
intro: Senecio oophyllus, commonly known as the "Pyrethrum", is a flowering plant species in the daisy family (Asteraceae). The plant has been used in traditional medicine for its various health benefits, which include treating fever, rheumatism, and skin conditions due to its anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of Senecio oophyllus include its ability to reduce pain and inflammation, as well as its antiseptic properties, which make it effective in treating wounds and skin infections. The bioactive constituents of Senecio oophyllus include sesquiterpene lactones, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
